newsitem.title: CANADA: Artisan to raise C$21.375 mln.
newsitem.headline: Artisan to raise C$21.375 mln.

text.p: Artisan Corp said on Thursday that it will raise C$21,375,000 in an agreement with a Canadian underwriting syndicate.
The money will be raised by the private placement of 1,500,000 special warrants at C$14.25 each, on an underwritten basis, Artisan said.
The syndicate is led by Peters & Co Ltd, Newcrest Capital Inc and RBC Dominion Securities Inc.
Each special warrant will be exchangeable into one common share at no additional cost, Artisan said.
Closing is subject to regulatory approval.
Artisan is an oil and gas service company operating in Western Canada.
